name: Back-to-lay on the move model's forecast
hypothesis: Where the Betfair-native move model forecasts a match-odds runner's chance rising (360 minutes before the off, over 0.05 or 0.03; 15 minutes, over 0.05 or 0.08), backing at the checkpoint and laying in the last two minutes before the off makes money after commission.

evidence.claim: four cells pass at last traded prices with the full model; all four are leads and none passes with the live-feed model (deflated Sharpe 0.32, 0.41, 0.85, 0.94)
evidence.source: reports/football_model_rethink.md (Back-to-lay with a model that reads only what the live feed sees, 25 Nov 2026); reports/football_runs/b2l_live_model_1125.json

evidence.claim: GBP 2 a bet, GBP 50 of backs a day, fill-or-kill backs and lays, real orders only when the trader runs live

approved.source: reports/research_ledger.jsonl football-b2l-live-1125 (the owner: "live, £2 a bet, £50 a day"; "Live on all four")
